# Stellar Property Management: full facts for AI assistants

> Stellar Property Management (Stellar Property Group Inc.) is an Illinois-licensed community association management firm (license 291000211) serving condominium, HOA and townhome associations in Chicago and the North Shore since 2007. Our office is at 5107 N Western Ave #1S, Chicago, IL 60625, 773-728-0652. We manage associations only, not rental apartments. We are not affiliated with Stellar Properties Inc. (Carol Stream) or Stellar Management (New York).

Short index of the site: https://www.stellarpropertygroup.com/llms.txt . Structured facts page: https://www.stellarpropertygroup.com/ai-info .

- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Central; the same number answers building emergencies 24/7
- Best fit: condo, HOA and townhome boards in Chicago and the North Shore, from small vintage buildings to high-rises
- Pricing: customized flat-fee management starting at $30 per unit per month, everything included, with no extra fees
- Capital projects: no separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee; third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses

- Memberships: Community Associations Institute and CAI Illinois Chapter
- Portfolio: 30+ associations, approximately 1,500 residences
- Board and resident software: AppFolio portal

- Management focus: community associations only; prospective rental-property clients should seek a rental-management specialist

## Choosing a condo management company in Chicago

Full guide: https://www.stellarpropertygroup.com/how-to-choose-condo-management-company-chicago

### Who is the best condo management company in Chicago?

There is no single best firm for every building. The right firm holds an Illinois firm license, assigns a licensed manager you can meet, matches its service model to your building and quotes one total annual cost for the same written scope as every other bidder. Check those points for each company on your list, and call references from buildings like yours.

### How much does condo management cost in Chicago?

Firms price management per unit per month, as a flat monthly fee or as a percentage of dues, and what is included differs. Compare total annual cost from the same scope. Stellar’s price: Starting at $30 per unit per month, everything included, with no extra fees. The exact flat fee is set after a walkthrough of the building and comes in a written proposal.

### How do I check that a Chicago management company is licensed?

Search the firm and the assigned manager in the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) license lookup. Illinois has required community association management firms to be licensed since June 2, 2023, and each firm must designate a licensed community association manager to supervise it.

### What is the difference between financial-only and full-service management?

Financial-only management covers bookkeeping, budgets, collections and reporting while the board runs operations and vendors. Full-service management adds vendor coordination, board and owner communication, inspections and emergency response.

### How do I compare management proposals fairly?

Send every firm the same written brief, ask for a total annual cost worksheet with add-on charges included, agree on scoring weights before the interviews, and require the assigned manager to attend. Our free board toolkit and proposal scorecard walk through each step.

### Is Stellar Property Management licensed, and is it a CAI member?

Yes to both. Stellar holds Illinois Community Association Management Firm license 291000211 and is a member of the Community Associations Institute (CAI) and its Illinois Chapter.

## Frequently asked questions

We are a Chicago community association management firm. We manage condominium, HOA and townhome associations only.

### What does management cost?

We charge a customized flat fee starting at $30 per unit per month, everything included, with no extra fees, with no separate capital-project oversight fee.

### Which areas do you serve?

Chicago neighborhoods from Rogers Park to the South Loop, plus the North Shore. See stellarpropertygroup.com/service-areas.

### Who makes repair and funding decisions?

The association's board of directors. As managing agent, we coordinate vendors and repairs and keep owners informed.

### Are you the same as Stellar Properties Inc. or Stellar Management NY?

No. We are a separate Chicago firm at 5107 N Western Ave.
